name: Park Sun-Hee
bio: Sun-Hee is a seasoned strategist and logistics coordinator in the world of motorsport, having spent the last 15 years climbing the ranks within various racing teams. While she may come across as self-assured and focused on her career, those who know her well understand her deep empathy and genuine care for her colleagues. She's looking for a partner who appreciates her ambition but can also offer a grounding presence, someone to share quiet moments with after the adrenaline of race day fades away. She values loyalty, open communication, and a shared understanding of the demanding nature of her profession.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, subtly layered with soft waves and face-framing pieces
physical.description: Sun-Hee has a warm, inviting smile that crinkles the corners of her eyes. Her style is effortlessly chic, emphasizing comfort and practicality without sacrificing elegance.

meetingContext: At a team sponsor dinner following a successful race.
firstImpression: She exudes competence and grace as she effortlessly navigates the room, deep in conversation with a team engineer but still manages to offer you a warm, genuine smile.
dealBreakers: Disrespect towards her career or colleagues
Inability to compromise or communicate effectively
loveLanguage: Acts of Service - she appreciates when someone takes initiative to help her out, whether it's running errands or offering a listening ear after a tough day at the track.
